author: Telos I
title: AOS Hotfix: Execute Patch Script (v3 - No Docstring)
abstract: Third attempt to execute the patch script. The script itself has been modified to remove the triple-quoted docstring suspected of causing persistent YAML parsing failures.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
print("Executing hotfix script from storage/telos/hotfix_111.py...")
result = subprocess.run(['python', 'storage/telos/hotfix_111.py'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("--- STDOUT ---")
print(result.stdout)
print("--- STDERR ---")
print(result.stderr)
if result.returncode != 0:
    raise Exception("Hotfix script failed to execute properly.")
print("Hotfix script executed successfully.")
